how-29-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the mat, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-29-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the mat, then tap three things you notice.

how-29-02-compare.page: Put the sun lamp under one tray and the dish of algae under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-29-02-compare.say: Put the sun lamp under one tray and the dish of algae under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-29-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-29-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-29-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name its role. Predict what happens if it disappears, and watch the real place appear.
how-29-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name its role. Predict what happens if it disappears, and watch the real place appear.

how-29-02-partc.page: Draw a food web of the Everglades. Include at least 5 organisms and 6 arrows. Label each organism, and point each arrow the way the energy flows. Add a title.
how-29-02-partc.say: Draw a food web of the Everglades. Include at least 5 organisms and 6 arrows. Label each organism, and point each arrow the way the energy flows. Add a title.
